control.description-key: PowerApps Component Framework control (PCF) that allows users to see records in a kanban view format.

property.name: config
property.description-key: ONE JSON for the whole control, replaces the individual properties below. Sections: view, board, card (incl. card.fields per field), filters, notifications. Example: {"card":{"fields":{"description":{"html":true,"maxHeightPx":160}}},"filters":{"quickFilters":["statuscode",{"field":"ownerid","inPopup":true}]}}. Resolved per setting: a value set here wins, otherwise the old property applies - so you can migrate step by step. To generate this JSON from your current settings, open the board and run copy(window.kanbanViewControlConfigExport) in the browser console. See README section Config.

property.name: defaultView
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: view.default.

property.name: filteredBusinessProcessFlows
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: view.bpf.exclude. Provide an array of strings with the business process flow names to filter out.

property.name: businessProcessFlowStepOrder
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: view.bpf.stageOrder. Provide a JSON array to control the order of business process flow stages (e.g. [{"id":"Develop","order":2}]).

property.name: disableBusinessProcessFlows
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: view.bpf.disable. When enabled, Business Process Flows are not loaded and not offered as views. Use this when the entity has no relevant BPFs (or you do not want them) to avoid unnecessary queries while the board loads.

property.name: hideViewBy
property.display-name-key: Hide View By if default View By set?
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: view.hide.

property.name: allowCardMove
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: board.allowCardMove. When disabled, cards cannot be moved by drag and drop.

property.name: cardMoveValidationFunction
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: board.cardMoveValidation.function. Optional global JavaScript function that is called before a card is moved to another column. Use together with Card move validation script (web resource) so the control loads the script when the view opens.

property.name: cardMoveValidationScript
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: board.cardMoveValidation.script. Optional web resource name (e.g. prefix_/scripts/kanban_validate.js). When set, the control loads this script when the view opens so the validation function is available without using the command bar.

property.name: showOpenInNewTabButton
property.display-name-key: Show open in new tab button on card
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: card.showOpenInNewTab. When enabled, each card shows a button (top right) that opens the record in a new browser tab.

property.name: showCreateActivityButton
property.display-name-key: Show create activity button on card
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: card.showCreateActivity. When enabled, each card shows a button to create an activity (e.g. task) linked to the record. Use with Activity entity type to choose task, appointment, etc.

property.name: createActivityEntityType
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: card.createActivityEntityType. Logical name of the activity entity to create from the card (e.g. task, appointment, email). Default: task. Only used when Show create activity button on card is enabled.

property.name: showSharePointFolderButton
property.display-name-key: Show SharePoint folder button on card
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: card.showSharePointFolder. When enabled, each card shows a button to open the related SharePoint folder in a new browser tab.

property.name: hideEmptyColumns
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: board.hideEmptyColumns. When enabled, columns that contain no cards are not shown.

property.name: hideColumnFieldOnCard
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: card.hideColumnField. When enabled, the field used for column grouping (View By) is not displayed on the card to save space.

property.name: hiddenFieldsOnCard
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: card.fields[field].hidden. Field logical names that are loaded but not displayed on cards. JSON array (e.g. ["field1","field2"]) or comma-separated list.

property.name: fieldsVisiblePerStage
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: card.fields[field].visibleInStages. Fields that are only shown on the card in certain columns. JSON object: field logical name -> array of column identifiers. For Business Process Flow: use stage names (e.g. Qualify, Develop). For OptionSet/dropdown columns: use the numeric option values (IDs), not the labels (e.g. ["1","2","3"]). Example: {"estimatedvalue":["Qualify","Develop"],"description":["2"]}. Fields not listed are visible in all columns.

property.name: htmlFieldsOnCard
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: card.fields[field].html. Field logical names whose content is rendered as HTML (sanitized). JSON array (e.g. ["field1","field2"]).

property.name: allowedHtmlTagsOnCard
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: card.html.allowedTags. Comma-separated list of allowed HTML tags for HTML fields on card. Default: p,br,b,i,u,strong,em,a,ul,ol,li,table,thead,tbody,tr,th,td. Empty = no tags (all HTML stripped). Add style only if needed and accept security risk (see Security in README).

property.name: allowedHtmlAttributesOnCard
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: card.html.allowedAttributes. Comma-separated list of allowed attributes for HTML fields on card (e.g. href for links). Default: href. Empty = no attributes.

property.name: hideLabelForFieldsOnCard
property.display-name-key: Hide label for fields on card
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: card.fields[field].hideLabel. Field logical names for which the label is hidden on the card. JSON array (e.g. ["field1","field2"]) or comma-separated list.

property.name: fieldDisplayNamesOnCard
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: card.fields[field].displayName. Assign custom display names to fields by logical name. JSON array (e.g. [{"logicalName":"estimatedvalue","displayName":"Value"}]). The display name is shown as the field label on the card.

property.name: booleanFieldHighlights
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: card.fields[field].highlight. JSON array: [{"logicalName":"fieldname","color":"#ff0000","type":"left"}]. Any field type (boolean, text, lookup, etc.). Empty = no highlight, filled = highlight. Optional type: left (default), right, cornerTopLeft, cornerTopRight, cornerBottomLeft, cornerBottomRight. left/right = colored border; corner = diagonal corner mark. First match per type wins.

property.name: cardBackgroundColors
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: card.fields[field].background. JSON array: [{"logicalName":"prioritycode","optionValue":1,"color":"#FDE7E9"}]. Colors the whole card background by field value. Use optionValue (numeric option id, also 1/0 for Yes/No) for Choice/Status/Yes-No columns - language independent. Use value (text, case-insensitive) for other field types. optionValue also accepts an array, e.g. [2,3]. First matching rule wins. Prefer light colors, the card text stays dark.

property.name: fieldWidthsOnCard
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: card.fields[field].width. JSON array to set percentage width of fields on the card (e.g. [{"logicalName":"description","width":100},{"logicalName":"estimatedvalue","width":50}]). Width 100 = full width, 50 = half, etc. Fields not listed use default width.

property.name: lookupFieldsAsPersonaOnCard
property.display-name-key: Lookup fields as Persona on card
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: card.fields[field].persona. Field logical names for which lookup values are shown with image/initials (Persona style). Other lookup fields are shown as a simple link. JSON array (e.g. ["ownerid"]) or comma-separated list.

property.name: lookupFieldsPersonaIconOnlyOnCard
property.display-name-key: Lookup Persona icon only on card
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: card.fields[field].persona = iconOnly. Field logical names for which Persona is shown with icon/initials only (no text). Only applies to fields also listed in Lookup fields as Persona on card. JSON array (e.g. ["ownerid"]) or comma-separated list.

property.name: showEmailAndPhoneAsLinks
property.display-name-key: Show E-Mail and Phone as links on card
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: card.showEmailAndPhoneAsLinks. When enabled, fields with type SingleLine.Email or SingleLine.Phone are shown as clickable mailto/tel links. The data type is read from the dataset; no per-field list needed.

property.name: ellipsisFieldsOnCard
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: card.fields[field].ellipsis. Field logical names for which the value is shown with text-overflow: ellipsis (single line, overflow hidden with ...). Other fields use multi-line clamp. JSON array (e.g. ["description"]) or comma-separated list.

property.name: lineBreakFieldsOnCard
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: card.fields[field].lineBreaks. Field logical names for which line breaks (newlines) in the value are displayed. Other text fields show content in one line or with clamped lines. JSON array (e.g. ["description"]) or comma-separated list.

property.name: fieldMaxHeightOnCard
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: card.fields[field].maxHeightPx. JSON array to set a maximum height (in pixels) for specific fields on the card (e.g. [{"logicalName":"description","maxHeightPx":80}]). Overflow is scrollable. Useful together with Line break fields on card for multi-line text.

property.name: quickFilterFields
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: filters.quickFilters. Field logical names to show as quick filter dropdowns (multiselect for all except Boolean). Use the exact column name from the dataset (e.g. ownerid for entity, or a_xxx.ownerid for linked-entity columns). Supports OptionSet, Lookup, and text fields. JSON array (e.g. ["statuscode","ownerid","a_c66099806c8349a18e63498da795a1a6.ownerid"]) or comma-separated list. Only fields present in the dataset can be used.

property.name: quickFilterFieldsInPopup
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: filters.quickFilters[].inPopup. Field logical names that are shown in a popup (e.g. "More filters") instead of inline, to save space and avoid wrapping. Must be a subset of Quick filter fields. JSON array (e.g. ["ownerid","statuscode"]) or comma-separated list.

property.name: sortFields
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: filters.sort.fields. Field logical names available for custom sorting (dropdown next to search). JSON array (e.g. ["createdon","estimatedvalue"]) or comma-separated list. Only fields present in the dataset can be used. Ascending/descending is selectable in the UI.

property.name: defaultSort
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: filters.sort.default. Default sort when no user preference is saved. JSON object: { "field": "logicalName" (e.g. estimatedvalue for revenue), "direction": "asc" | "desc" }. Only applies if the field is also listed in Sort fields. Example: { "field": "estimatedvalue", "direction": "desc" } for revenue descending.

property.name: filterPresets
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: filters.presets. JSON array of filter presets. Each preset: { "id": "unique-id", "label": "Display name", "filters": { "fieldLogicalName": "value" or ["value1","value2"] } }. For multiselect use array; for Boolean single value. Use "{{currentUser}}" for current user (e.g. ownerid). Date fields: "today", "last7", "last30", "currentMonth", "currentYear", "currentWeek", "nextWeek", "nextMonth", "YYYY-MM-DD|YYYY-MM-DD", or { "start": "YYYY-MM-DD", "end": "YYYY-MM-DD" }. Number/currency fields: "gt:123", "lt:456", "gte:0", "lte:10000", "between:100|5000". Add "default": true to a preset to apply it automatically on first load (until the user changes filters). Example: [{ "id": "my-opportunities", "label": "Meine Opportunities", "default": true, "filters": { "ownerid": "{{currentUser}}" } }, { "id": "high-value", "label": "Umsatz > 10000", "filters": { "estimatedvalue": "gt:10000" } }].

property.name: expandBoardToFullWidth
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: board.fullWidth. When enabled, the board uses the full view width and columns scale proportionally.

property.name: minColumnWidth
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: board.minColumnWidth. Minimum width of each column in pixels. Also applies when "Expand board to full width" is enabled; horizontal scrolling is used if needed. Leave empty for default (400).

property.name: maxColumnWidth
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: board.maxColumnWidth. Maximum width of each column (and cards) in pixels. Leave empty for no limit.

property.name: initialCardsVisible
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: board.initialCardsVisible. Number of cards shown per column initially; more load when scrolling down. Leave empty for default (30).

property.name: columnWidths
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: board.columnWidths. JSON array to set width per column. Each item: "id" (column id, e.g. BPF stage name or option value) and "width" (pixels, 200-1200). Example: [{"id":"Develop","width":280}].

property.name: allowCreateNew
property.display-name-key: Allow creating new records from board
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: board.allowCreateNew. When disabled, the add button on each column is hidden and new records cannot be created from the board.

property.name: notificationPosition
property.description-key: DEPRECATED - use Config: notifications.position. Choose the position where the toast message should appear
